title: coronopus incisus
intro: Coronopus incisus, commonly known as land cress or garden peppercress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. The leaves of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and aiding in digestion. Coronopus incisus is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Coronopus incisus include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
